title: Black bear in Kanata tranquilized, relocated by police
text: Black bear in Kanata tranquilized, relocated by police A bear seen wandering through Kanata South on Thursday was tranquillized and transported to a safer location, according to local police. A bear seen wandering through Kanata South on Thursday was tranquillized and transported to a safer location, according to local police. We are working with our partners to continually review and improve the results. Ottawa police say they tranquillized and transported a black bear to a safer location after it was reported in Kanata. A black bear seen wandering through parts of Kanata Thursday was tranquillized and transported to a safer location, Ottawa police say.\"It seems our adventurous friend was doing a little exploring before settling in for a long winter’s nap,\" Ottawa Police Service said in a social media post Thursday afternoon. Earlier in the day, police warned residents that a bear was spotted in the Morgan’s Grant Woods Park area. It was also reported in the backyard of a nearby residence.Police have asked those in the area to consider removing any bird feeders or other food sources from yards to avoid attracting other unwanted animals. Ottawa police say the bear was spotted in areas across Kanata, including near Klondike and March Roads.
